world_read.summary: A broad, near-black island filled with colored dots and short dashes dominates the left edge. Two disconnected cyan-white ribbon clusters loop across the upper right and lower middle, with a smaller patterned island at right. Gold particle trails bridge portions of the composition against violet-blue light; warm arcs sweep across the top and bottom. The plate is abstract and expressionist, but its dense particles and fine ribbon lines make it more intricate than minimal.
